entities.summary: Kate Bashabe is a Rwandan entrepreneur and philanthropist known as the founder of the Kabash brand and the Kabash Cares charity organization. She is recognized for her contributions to Rwanda’s fashion industry and her efforts in supporting underprivileged communities.
